title: Kagamine Rin — Brand New Stage〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ahhh...!
My body feels a whole lot lighter after resting for a day♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (That training with MEIKO really was tough... In the beginning, doing sets of fifty for each strength exercise was super hard...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
30... 31...!
M-My arms are like jelly... I, I can't...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Your form is better than yesterday, so you're doing great!
Okay, now rest your arms while doing some jump rope♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Am I actually gonna be able to rest them...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (And there were days when I couldn't move for a while after I'd finished.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But now I'm able to stick through to the end, so I feel like I'm pretty amazing now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO, I'm here for another day of... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry to butt in, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, are you here to help since we'll be rehearsing today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That is part of it, of course...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, I asked KAITO to prepare a little something.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A little something?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Ta-daa, they're accessories for the day of our show♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hair accessories, bracelets, necklaces...!
W-Wow! They're all so cute!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Aren't they? I asked him to bring things that would fit the songs you'll sing and the outfits you'll wear, as a reward for all your hard work training.
Right, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wooow...!
Thank you, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're welcome...is what I would say, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's thanks to Airi and the others that I was able to bring this many.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Airi and the others?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes. MEIKO can't exactly be going all over the place while she's training you.
So, I went to ask them about any accessory ideas on her behalf.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To explain things better, I mentioned that you've been doing special training...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And when I did, Airi said—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Leave it to us!
We'll find the perfect accessories for Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Girls...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
The four of them found this wonderful shop.
That's how I was able to get these accessories.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So that's what happened...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But is this alright?
Can I really accept such beautiful accessories...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well... I was a bit surprised too when KAITO told me about this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I think you've worked hard enough to fully earn those.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Airi and the others were shocked to hear about what you were doing.
They couldn't believe you were undergoing such intense training.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They were really burning with motivation, saying they couldn't let themselves get left behind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It might've also been their way of thanking you for setting their hearts ablaze.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I started this because I wanted to do my best not to get left behind everyone in MORE MORE JUMP!...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I guess I got them fired up instead!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sounds like a good thing to me.
Serving as one another's inspiration, pushing each other to get better...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe, if they're all on fire now, I'll need to work harder and harder♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Are we going to train today, MEIKO?
When will our rehearsals start?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, yes. Shall we start with our circuit training to warm up?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hahaha... So that's “warming up” to you two.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe, do you wanna join, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?! I-I have something I need to do, so...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Rin & MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
